title: A New Strategy for Artificial Intelligence: Training Foundation Models Directly on Human Brain Data
abstract: arXiv:2601.12053v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While foundation models have achieved remarkable results across a diversity of domains, they still rely on human-generated data, such as text, as a fundamental source of knowledge. However, this data is ultimately the product of human brains, the filtered projection of a deeper neural complexity. In this paper, we explore a new strategy for artificial intelligence: moving beyond surface-level statistical regularities by training foundation models directly on human brain data. We hypothesize that neuroimaging data could open a window into elements of human cognition that are not accessible through observable actions, and argue that this additional knowledge could be used, alongside classical training data, to overcome some of the current limitations of foundation models. While previous research has demonstrated the possibility to train classical machine learning, deep learning, or reinforcement learning models on neural patterns

translated_title: 人工智能的新策略：直接在人类大脑数据上训练基础模型
translated_abstract: 尽管基础模型已经在众多领域取得了显著成果，但它们仍然依赖人类生成的数据（如文本）作为知识的基本来源。然而，这些数据归根结底是人类大脑的产物，是更深层次神经复杂性的过滤投影。在本文中，我们探索一种人工智能的新策略：通过直接在人类大脑数据上训练基础模型，超越表层的统计规律。我们假设神经影像数据可以为我们打开一扇窗口，揭示通过可观察行为无法获取的人类认知要素，并论证这些额外知识可以与传统训练数据相结合，用以克服基础模型当前的一些局限性。虽然此前的研究已经证明了在神经模式上训练经典机器学习、深度学习或强化学习模型的可能性……
tldr: 本文提出了一种人工智能新策略——直接在人类大脑数据（神经影像数据）上训练基础模型，以获取文本等人类生成数据无法体现的认知信息，从而克服基础模型的现有局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new AI strategy of training foundation models directly on human brain (neuroimaging) data, aiming to access cognitive information not captured by human-generated data like text and to overcome the current limitations of foundation models.
